channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: "48 Hours" show schedule
item.description: True crime. Real justice. To miss it would be a crime.

item.title: Trump dismisses threats from Iran's security chief: "I couldn't care less"
item.description: In a phone interview with CBS News, President Trump dismissed threats from Iran's top national-security official, who posted on social media that Mr. Trump must "pay the price" for the strikes on Iran.

item.title: Suspicious devices ignited during protests near Mamdani's residence, NYPD says
item.description: New York City police said suspicious devices were ignited Saturday during clashing protests outside Gracie Mansion, the official residence of Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Manhattan's Upper East Side.

item.title: Book excerpt: "Apple: The First 50 Years" by David Pogue
item.description: The "CBS Sunday Morning" correspondent's latest book examines how, in its first half-century, the company founded by Steve Wozniak and Steve Jobs remade the culture – and then, incredibly, remade itself.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (March 8)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: It's time to "spring forward" for daylight saving. Here's what to know.
item.description: The time change known as daylight savings starts Sunday, March 8, 2026. Most Americans lose an hour of sleep when clocks "spring forward."

item.title: Judge voids Kari Lake's actions as acting CEO of U.S. media agency
item.description: A federal judge ruled Saturday that Kari Lake did not have legal authority to take the actions she's done to largely dismantle the Voice of America.

item.title: No injuries after explosion reported near U.S. Embassy in Norway, local police say
item.description: Norwegian police reported on Sunday an explosion near the U.S. Embassy in the capital Oslo, but said there were no casualties.

item.title: Trump vows to hit Iran "very hard," says he has no war timetable: "Whatever it takes"
item.description: President Trump warned Iran that it would be "hit very hard," after calling for the country's "unconditional surrender."

item.title: The Woman Who Died Twice
item.description: A woman's body is found in a swamp, murdered. Impossible, say friends, who learned she'd died in a hospital five months earlier. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.
